item.description: The `run` function has incorrect iteration logic. It iterates over `stages` instead of `stage` after converting it with `to_iterable`.
item.contract: The `run` function should iterate over the converted `stage` variable, not the original `stages` list.

item.description: The `Concat` class's `apply` method doesn't properly handle multiple stage inputs. It's missing the logic to iterate through dependencies and put items into output queues.
item.contract: The `Concat.apply` method should properly iterate through all dependency stages and put their items into the output queue.

item.description: The `Stage.__iter__` method incorrectly calls `to_iterable()` instead of returning the iterator directly.
item.contract: The `Stage.__iter__` method should return `iter(self.to_iterable())` directly, not call it.

item.description: The `Stage.to_iterable` method lacks proper error handling and pipeline error checking.
item.contract: The `Stage.to_iterable` method should check for pipeline errors and propagate them correctly.

item.description: The `to_iterable` function has an incorrect implementation. It doesn't properly handle the conversion of stage objects to iterables.
item.contract: The `to_iterable` function should correctly convert stage objects to their iterable representation.
